title: The Hill I Was Not Looking At

content.caption: A green slope rolls down toward the viewer under a pale sky, with a big dark tree trunk on the left and a few smaller pine and round trees dotted along the crest. A low brown building with a red roof sits in the middle distance, and a thin grey post stands at the far right.
content.opinion: The lamp I meant to photograph is nowhere in this picture, which is typical of this island, but the hill is at least mine to look at.
